release_notes:
v1.2.3 Release - Waveshare CAN Variable-Length Renaming, Dedicated 20-Byte Preset & Self-Healing Stream Resynchronization.

Changes:
  - Explicit 'waveshare_can_variable_length' Parser: Renamed parser type identifier across all UI dialogs, wizards, and Excel template validators for maximum clarity while preserving full backward compatibility with 'waveshare_can'.
  - Out-of-the-Box Fixed 20-Byte Preset: Added dedicated 'Waveshare USB-CAN (Fixed 20-Byte)' preset to the preset catalog and Welcome Dashboard for 1-click loading.
  - Self-Healing Sliding-Window Resync: Enhanced fixed 20-byte CAN parser with dynamic boundary sliding window recovery (k=19 byte detection) so physical line drops or high-baud FIFO glitches immediately re-align on the next packet without cascading checksum errors.
  - Startup Serial Buffer Purge: Automatically flushes serial input buffers upon opening COM ports to eliminate cold-boot stale byte fragments.
  - Robust Logging Timestamps: Bulletproofed timestamp ingestion across Raw and Decoded loggers to seamlessly support datetime, epoch floats, and automatic clock fallbacks.
  - High-DPI Warning Cleanup: Suppressed benign Qt Windows GDI platform display enumeration warnings.
